messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — NovaHealth onboarding: they asked for a privacy deck + DPA evidence + vendor risk form filled. They want this by EOW.
Liam O'Connor: Okay. Which specific evidence items do they need? checklist would help.
Anika Patel: We have SOC2 report link but not the test evidence zip. I can start pulling docs.
Maya Chen: Key ask: dataflow diagrams, key management/KMS details, data retention policy, subprocessors list, and sample DPA clause redlines.
Liam O'Connor: For dataflow, I'll grab the diagram from infra docs and ask eng for egress flow. pinging @tom on security for KMS specifics.
Tom Reyes: I got it. Will add KMS key rotation schedule, key IDs (redacted), and whether we use customer-managed keys. ETA tomorrow AM.
Anika Patel: Drafting a shareable package. Quick question — legal ok to share SOC2 test evidence artifacts?
Sophie Lang (Legal): You can share SOC2 summary & auditors' report. For test evidence, redact user identifiers and remove PII; use secure transfer (one-time S3 link). I'll sign off on the redaction.
Maya Chen: Perfect — add that to the checklist. Also, NovaHealth's vendor risk form has a free-text field about data residency guarantees; product only supports region pinning at org level. We'll need to call out limitations.
Liam O'Connor: I'll mark that as a known-gap under 'operational constraints' and propose mitigation: dedicated routing + contractual language.
SecurityBot: New internal ticket created: VRF-2026 — "NovaHealth KMS + dataflow evidence". Link: https://redwood.tools/vrf/2026
Asha Kapoor: FYI I'm the AM on this account, will schedule a 30-min enablement to walk through the deck with the customer next Tue. Also flagging a renewal risk: they said retention limits are a gating concern.
Maya Chen: Thanks Asha — adding a renewal risk note. Action items:
```
- Anika: compile SOC2 summary, redacted evidence, subprocessors list (due Thu)
- Tom: KMS details + rotation docs (due tomorrow AM)
- Liam: dataflow diagram + operational constraints note (due Thu)
- Sophie: sign-off on redaction + sharing mechanism (ASAP)
- Asha: schedule enablement + capture renewal concern for CSM playbook
```
Maya Chen: I'll consolidate into a single ZIP and send secure link once Sophie confirms redactions. :thumbsup:
Tom Reyes: Taking items 2 & 3.
Anika Patel: Starting compilation now, will update thread with link when ready.
Maya Chen: Great — thanks team. I'll follow up if the customer pushes the deadline earlier.
